gui.vanillatalents.select_class.title: Choose your class

gui.vanillatalents.respec.message: Fee: %s levels. TP spent on current class: %s. TP refunded: %s. Your current class tree will be reset; the Common tree is not affected.
talent.vanillatalents.common_health.name: Vitality
talent.vanillatalents.common_regen.name: Natural Recovery
talent.vanillatalents.common_regen.desc: Natural regeneration (hunger ≥ 18) is 10% faster per level
−10% exhaustion from natural health regeneration per level
talent.vanillatalents.common_breath.name: Deep Breath
talent.vanillatalents.common_aqua.name: Amphibious Hands
talent.vanillatalents.common_aqua.desc: −25% underwater mining penalty per level (level 2 ≈ partial Aqua Affinity)
talent.vanillatalents.common_fireproof.d: −6% fire damage (fire, burning, magma) per level
talent.vanillatalents.common_antidote.de: −10% duration of Poison and Hunger (effect) per level
talent.vanillatalents.common_lava.name: Hardened Feet
talent.vanillatalents.common_second_wind: When dropping to ≤ 4 health (2 hearts), gain Regeneration II for 4 s. 5 min cooldown.
6% chance per level for each armor piece to lose no durability when taking damage
talent.vanillatalents.common_iron_gut.de: Eating rotten flesh or raw chicken does not apply the Hunger effect
−50% freezing damage (powder snow) per level; level 2 = immune
talent.vanillatalents.common_willpower.d: −10% duration of Slowness, Weakness and Mining Fatigue per level
talent.vanillatalents.miner_haste.name: Tireless Arms
talent.vanillatalents.miner_deepslate.de: Additional +15% speed on deepslate, tuff, basalt and blackstone per level
talent.vanillatalents.miner_mole.name: Mole Hands
talent.vanillatalents.miner_mole.desc: +10% shovel digging speed (dirt, gravel, sand, clay) per level
talent.vanillatalents.miner_durability.d: 8% chance per level for pickaxes/shovels not to lose durability
talent.vanillatalents.miner_fortune.name: Midas Touch
talent.vanillatalents.miner_fortune.desc: 5% chance per level of an extra ore drop (stacks with Fortune)
talent.vanillatalents.miner_ore_xp.name: Vein of Knowledge
talent.vanillatalents.miner_ore_xp.desc: +10% XP from ores (coal, lapis, redstone, diamond, emerald, quartz) per level
talent.vanillatalents.miner_prospector.d: Crouch still for 2 s: ores within 2/4/6 blocks get a colored outline, visible through walls, for 3 s. 10 s cooldown.
talent.vanillatalents.miner_footing.name: Sure Footing
talent.vanillatalents.miner_footing.desc: −50% of the mining penalty when not on the ground (ladders, scaffolding, swimming) per level
talent.vanillatalents.miner_stoneskin.de: −8% damage from explosions and falling blocks per level
talent.vanillatalents.miner_lavasense.de: Touching lava below Y 0 grants Fire Resistance for 3 s. 90/60/30 s cooldown.
talent.vanillatalents.miner_vein.name: Vein
talent.vanillatalents.miner_vein.desc: While crouching, breaking an ore also breaks up to 4/8/12 connected ores of the same type. Each extra block costs durability and exhaustion as usual.
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_harvest.des: 10% chance per level for a mature crop to drop +1 produce (wheat, carrot, potato, beetroot, nether wart)
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_area_harves: Harvesting a mature crop with a hoe also harvests adjacent mature crops. Level 1: cross (5 blocks). Level 2: 3×3.
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_hoe_care.de: 15% chance per level for hoes not to lose durability
Walking or jumping on farmland does not trample it
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_animal_drop: 10% chance per level of an extra drop (leather, meat, wool, feathers, rabbit) when killing livestock
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_shearing.de: 15% chance per level of +1 wool when shearing
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_twins.name: Litter
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_twins.desc: 5% chance per level of an extra baby being born
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_growth_aura: Every 5 s, each crop within 3/4/5 blocks has a 5% chance to grow 1 stage
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_bonemeal.de: 15% chance per level for bone meal not to be consumed
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_forester.de: +10% chance per level of extra saplings and apples from leaves; Fertile Aura also affects saplings, sugar cane, cactus and bamboo
talent.vanillatalents.farmer_replant.des: Every hoe harvest (including Wide Scythe) replants automatically, using a seed from its own drops
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_step.name: High Stride
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_step.desc: Step up 1-block ledges without jumping. Disabled while crouching.
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_terrain.d: −25% slowdown from soul sand/soil, powder snow, honey and sweet berries per level
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_mounts.de: +5% mount speed (horse, donkey, mule, camel) per level
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_fall.name: Landing
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_safe_heig: +1 block of safe fall height per level (vanilla: 3)
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_roll.name: Roll
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_roll.desc: Landing while crouching reduces the remaining fall damage by a further 20%
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_jump.name: Light Jump
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_jump.desc: −20% jumping exhaustion (including while sprinting) per level
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_swim.name: Swimmer
talent.vanillatalents.explorer_featherfo: Falls of up to 12 blocks deal no damage. Beyond that, damage counts from the 13th block, with the usual reductions.
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_strength.d: +0.5 melee damage with swords and axes per level
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_sweep.name: Sweep
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_sweep.desc: +0.15 sword sweeping damage ratio per level
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_crit.name: Precise Strike
Killing a hostile mob with a sword heals 1 health (half a heart) per level. 2 s cooldown.
+5% attack speed with axes per level
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_armor_brea: Axe attacks ignore 5% of the target's armor per level
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_executione: +10% damage per level against targets below 30% health
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_resistance: −4% physical damage taken (melee and projectiles) per level
Natural knockback: level 1 = half of Knockback I; level 2 = Knockback I. Does not stack beyond Knockback II.
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_shield.des: −25% shield disable time after an axe hit per level
talent.vanillatalents.warrior_cleave.des: Fully charged axe attacks deal 40% damage to up to 3 hostile enemies within 1.5 blocks of the target
talent.vanillatalents.archer_aim.name: Eagle Eye
talent.vanillatalents.archer_aim.desc: +4% damage from arrows and thrown tridents per level
talent.vanillatalents.archer_draw.name: Quick Draw
talent.vanillatalents.archer_draw.desc: −6% bow full-draw time per level (vanilla: 1 s)
talent.vanillatalents.archer_steady.name: Steady Hand
talent.vanillatalents.archer_mobile.name: Running Shot
talent.vanillatalents.archer_mobile.desc: −25% movement slowdown while drawing a bow per level
talent.vanillatalents.archer_reload.name: Swift Reload
talent.vanillatalents.archer_reload.desc: −8% crossbow reload time per level (vanilla: 1.25 s)
talent.vanillatalents.archer_bolt.name: Heavy Bolt
talent.vanillatalents.archer_bolt.desc: +8% damage of crossbow-fired arrows per level
talent.vanillatalents.archer_firework.de: +10% damage of crossbow-fired rockets per level
talent.vanillatalents.archer_conserve.de: 8% chance per level not to consume the arrow (includes tipped and spectral arrows)
talent.vanillatalents.archer_recover.des: Arrows that hit a mob have a 20% chance per level to drop when it dies
talent.vanillatalents.archer_longshot.de: +10% damage per level when the target is more than 20 blocks away
talent.vanillatalents.archer_marker.name: Marker
talent.vanillatalents.archer_marker.desc: Arrows that hit apply Glowing to the target for 2 s per level
talent.vanillatalents.archer_pierce.name: Piercing Arrow
talent.vanillatalents.archer_pierce.desc: Fully drawn bow arrows pass through 1 extra target (like Piercing I), dealing 70% damage to the second target
gui.vanillatalents.summary.hint: Click a node to see its details. Double-click buys.
gui.vanillatalents.classes.title: Classes
gui.vanillatalents.classes.reset: TP spent that will be reset: %s
gui.vanillatalents.classes.common_safe: The Common Tree is not affected.
vanillatalents.class.miner.desc: Underground and mining: faster breaking, bonus ores and night vision.
vanillatalents.class.farmer.desc: Farming and ranching: area harvest, extra animal drops and an aura that speeds up crops.
vanillatalents.class.explorer.desc: Exploration and mobility: more speed, less fall damage and less hunger while sprinting.
vanillatalents.class.warrior.desc: Melee combat: more damage with swords and axes, knockback and resistance.
vanillatalents.class.archer.desc: Ranged combat: faster draw and reload, extra projectile damage and saved arrows.
